meta_description: BD Plastering specialises in internal and external plastering across Manchester. Fast, reliable work with a personal touch. Get a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Experienced Plasterer — Quality Finish Every Time
hero_subhead: Cracked walls, damp patches, or a room that needs replastering? We deliver smooth, professional finishes on time and on budget.
services_subhead: From small patch repairs to whole-room replastering, we handle domestic and commercial projects with precision and care.

services.title: Internal Wall Plastering
services.desc: Smooth, flat finishes on new builds, extensions, and renovation projects. We prep properly and deliver a surface ready for paint or wallpaper.

services.title: Ceiling Plastering & Repair
services.desc: Sagging ceilings, cracks, and water damage fixed. We reinforce and resurface to restore a clean, level finish that lasts.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant external renders protect your walls and boost kerb appeal. We use quality finishes that resist cracking and damp ingress.

services.title: Patch Repairs & Skimming
services.desc: Small holes, dents, and cracks repaired and skimmed to blend seamlessly with existing walls. No need to replaster the whole room.

services.title: Damp & Water Damage Repair
services.desc: After damp treatment, we replaster affected areas with moisture-resistant board and finish to prevent further damage.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial Plastering
services.desc: Retail spaces, offices, and warehouses replastered to specification. We work around your schedule and minimise disruption.

about_pullquote: I started plastering because I saw poor finishes everywhere—I wanted to do it right.
about_para_1: BD Plastering was founded on a simple principle: turn up on time, do the job properly, and charge fairly. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation across Manchester for reliable, high-quality work—from small residential repairs to larger commercial projects. Our team takes pride in every finish, whether it's a single wall or a whole building.
about_para_2: Most of our work comes from repeat customers and referrals. We listen to what you need, give honest advice, and don't cut corners. A good plaster finish isn't just about looks—it protects your walls and adds real value to your home. That's why we get called back, time and again.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the entire lounge replastered after a leak. BD Plastering was brilliant—turned up when they said they would, got it done in two days, and the finish is immaculate. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Small crack in my bedroom ceiling was driving me mad. Called BD and they came out the same week. Fixed it quickly, tidied up properly, and charged a fair price. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Helen R.

reviews.text: Needed external rendering on our semi after damp issues. They knew exactly what they were doing, explained everything clearly, and the work looks great. No mess, no fuss. Really pleased.
reviews.author: David K.

address_sub: Serving all of Greater Manchester and surrounding areas

footer_description: BD Plastering is a trusted Manchester-based plasterer with over 15 years' experience. We specialise in internal and external plastering, repairs, and renovation work.
